integrity: Finite exhaustion implemented with complete-prefix invariant; independent C++ enumeration; no external audit or claim of independently certified priority.
scientific_limitations: Exactly nine distinct coefficients modulo 56 with distinct unordered two-index sums and known exact two-loss count; previous research proves 56 is minimal. Does not address repeated-index sums, more errors, different lengths, or the performance of full composite-DNA codes. Full historical priority remains unsettled because the complete 2004 cyclic manuscript was not accessible.
title: Rigidity of optimal nine-position modular two-loss checksums
